name: admin-mixed-values
steps: Open the mixed collection in the sidebar.
Assert that a document shows max 9223372036854775807 and min -9223372036854775808.
Assert that a document shows nan as NaN.
Assert that a document shows bytes as binary AAEC/w==.
Assert that a document shows a date 2026-03-01T12:00:00Z.
Assert that a document shows the nested array [1, [2, 3], {"deep": true}].
Switch the documents view to Table.
Assert that the table lists 9 documents.
Open the document whose value is "just text" from the table.
Assert that the document editor shows "just text".
